title: The Fourth, the week before
logline: The dock a week before the Fourth: the one firework, still in its wrapper, on the shack's counter beside the tin, and the girl, fourteen, looking at it. The page knows who'll light it next year.

panels.composition: A single wrapped firework lying on a shop counter beside a pushpin tin, a fourteen-year-old girl from behind looking down at it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a single wrapped firework lying on a shop counter beside a pushpin tin with a fourteen-year-old girl seen from behind looking down at it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
